executiveSummary: Harbor Logistics needs a faster, mobile-friendly customer portal. This proposal covers discovery, design, build, and a phased launch over twelve weeks.
problem: The current portal is difficult to use on mobile, order status updates are delayed, and support tickets spike after each release.
scope: We will deliver a responsive portal, real-time shipment tracking, self-service account updates, and an admin dashboard for support staff.

deliverables.item: UI design system and key screens
Portal MVP with tracking and account area
